name.zh: Clypeina 相连繁殖轮盘标本

description.en: Use one documented connected pair of whorls with coarse radial divisions; do not extrapolate a tall unknown stalk.
description.zh: 使用一对有记录的相连轮盘及粗放射分区，不外推未知高轴。

sources.title: Aloisalthella and Clypeina: a systematic revision
sources.supports: Clypeina marginoporella fertile whorls and distinction from Jurassic forms.
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.rights_note: Consultation is not a license to redistribute source media.

reconstruction_notes.en: Fossil-specimen only: one connected pair of shallow funnel-like whorl discs, coarse radial divisions and a hollow short axial connection. Original limited thickness, small rim irregularity, muted fossil palette and nominal 0.075 m span are teaching art choices. No unknown tall stalk, sterile laterals, roots, complete parent thallus or mechanical gear/coin-stack substitution. No copied source models or figures; exact pore counts and microscopic wall anatomy are not claimed.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 仅化石标本：一对相连浅漏斗状轮盘、粗放射分区与短中空轴连接。有限厚度、轻微不规则边缘、柔和化石色和0.075米名义跨度为教学美术设定。不添加未知高茎、不育轮枝、根或完整母藻，不用机械齿轮或硬币堆替代。不复制来源模型或图像；不主张精确孔数及微观壁结构。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
